name: File Operations — Read, Write, Append, Copy, Delete
description: Practice reading, writing, appending, copying, and deleting files.

tasks.description: First create a file named log.txt with content 'Start'. Then append ' Middle' to it. Then append ' End' to it. The final file should contain 'Start Middle End'.
Create a file named source.txt with content 'Copy me'. Then copy it to destination.txt. Both files should exist with the same content.
tasks.expected_outcome: source.txt and destination.txt both exist with identical content

tasks.description: Create a file named data.txt with any content. Use the file_metadata action to check its size. Then write the size (in bytes) to a file called size.txt.
tasks.expected_outcome: data.txt exists and size.txt contains the file size
